name: FSL Top-up & Eddy Correct & QC
summary: The application performs correction of susceptibility-induced distortions, eddy current–related artifacts, and subject motion by leveraging the Topup and Eddy tools from FSL.

inputs.description: The path to the DWI datatype
Reverse encoded dwi image needed to run top-up

outputs.description: Final corrected diffusion data after TOPUP + EDDY.
Brain mask derived from the corrected mean b0 image.
Archived intermediate files produced during preprocessing. This directory ensures reproducibility and debugging capability.
Quality control outputs generated by FSL eddy_quad.
Tabular motion and distortion parameters for downstream modeling.

If, for whatever reason, the two DWI images do not have the same number of slices, set reslice to true and it will reslice the rdif image to diff
If enabled, the application performs skull stripping on the DWI data to generate a brain mask for use during the top-up step.

If set to true, the pipeline will use eddy_cuda instead of eddy_openmp to perform motion and eddy-current correction.
eddy_cuda enables GPU acceleration of the EDDY step and can substantially reduce processing time on compatible systems.

Set to true only if the diffusion acquisition is approximately multi-shell or single-shell, as expected by FSL eddy --data_is_shelled. Leave as false for non-shelled acquisitions (for example DSI or other irregular q-space sampling), since forcing this option on unsuitable data can cause eddy to fail.
